payload.props_realized: Every value prop is realized by a story: the pairing prop -> STORY 1 (killer, UC-1); the secrecy prop -> STORY 2 (UC-2); the toolbar prop -> STORY 3 (UC-3).
payload.stories_generalized: Every story sits inside a use case: STORY 1 -> UC-1, STORY 2 -> UC-2, STORY 3 -> UC-3; each with a main path (UC-1 also carries extensions).
payload.roles_covered: No role left out: owner, driving agent, adjudicator, maintainer, and the external phone (subscribes + scans). Tensions named: one-gesture vs config-chore; topic-secrecy vs hosted-QR convenience; one-click install vs zero-dep.
payload.excluded_stated: The binding excluded-use list exists (draw_context): no QR decode / inbound, no external image/QR service, no change to the i8 bless auth, no non-ntfy channels, no book (i6), no live owner-physical pairing.
payload.examples_formulated: The scenario paths ARE the formulated examples: UC-1 main + ext 2a (phone.json exists) + ext 4a (encode failure -> no partial write), UC-2 (no external call), UC-3 (toolbar render). These seed the M7 red-first tests + the M8 acceptance.
